+        app((a + b, chr(idx), a, b))
+    return table
+
+
+def _apply_table(s, table):
+    """
+    Same as s = s.replace(ps, c) for every entry of table in order, but a
+    replace is skipped when one of the pair's tokens cannot be in s (such a
+    replace finds nothing). present is a superset of the characters of s:
+    a replace only removes characters, except for the minted token c.
+    """
+    present = set(s)
+    add = present.add
+    for ps, c, a, b in table:
+        if a in present and b in present:
+            n = len(s)
+            s = s.replace(ps, c)
+            if len(s) != n:
+                add(c)
+    return s
